_doc: Green Home Score sub-score mappings v0.1. Fixed weights from the problem statement. Every mapping is monotonic (better state never lowers the sub-score) and is unit-tested. Piecewise-linear 'points' are [x, sub_score] pairs, linearly interpolated, clamped at the ends. Owner: Physics & Bayesian lead. Changes need a PR + updated tests.
rounding: Round final weighted sum to nearest integer (half up) before classification.

energy_efficiency.input: EPC SAP score (1-100); if only band is known use band midpoint
energy_efficiency.justification: Problem statement: energy efficiency must reflect the recorded energy rating.

energy_intensity.input: Annualised metered purchased energy (grid electricity import + gas) / floor area, kWh/m2/yr, weather-normalised to a typical year
energy_intensity.missing_rule: If < 6 months metered data: impute from twin posterior and flag; if none: use twin-modelled intensity, widen interval, add warning.
energy_intensity.justification: Metered, per m2, so large homes are not penalised for size; distinct from the rating-based component.

insulation.renormalise_when_absent: Flats with a dwelling above drop 'roof'; with a dwelling below drop 'floor'; remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1.
insulation.justification: Insulation is an actionable lever; overlap with the EPC rating is accepted and documented: the rating is an overall modelled outcome, components are the levers customers can change.

heating_system.input: Main heating system (+ age for boilers)
heating_system.age_adjustment: Boilers: -1 point per year over 12 years old, floor 0.
heating_system.justification: Ordered by delivered-heat carbon intensity and seasonal efficiency.

renewable_energy.input: PV kWp, battery kWh, solar thermal

smart_energy_management.rule: Highest level whose requirements are all present.
